missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative predicate. 'Преступление' is a neuter noun in the nominative case as the predicate noun. 'Серьёзное' is the agreeing neuter adjective, intensified by 'очень'.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Преступление' is the accusative direct object of 'расследует'. Neuter nouns keep the same form in the accusative, and 'это' agrees in the neuter.
Strategic focus: Genitive of belonging. 'Преступления' is the genitive form showing whose witnesses are meant. 'Этого' agrees in the neuter genitive, and 'нет' takes the genitive 'свидетелей'.

missions.phrase: К преступлению привели жадность и страх.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Dative with 'к'. 'Преступлению' is the dative form after 'к', expressing what the causes led to. 'Жадность' and 'страх' are the nominative subjects.
Strategic focus: Instrumental with 'над'. 'Преступлением' is the instrumental form after 'над' meaning working on something. 'Этим' agrees in the neuter, and 'следователи' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'В преступлении' uses the prepositional form 'преступлении' after 'в' to mark involvement. 'Банк' is the nominative subject, and 'замешан' is a short participle.
Strategic focus: Prepositional with 'в'. 'Преступлении' is the prepositional form after 'в' used with accusation verbs. 'Тяжком' is the agreeing neuter prepositional adjective.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. After 'много' the noun takes the genitive plural 'преступлений', a zero-ending form ending in -ий for neuter nouns in -ие. 'В городе' is the location.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Преступления' is the nominative plural subject. 'Все' and 'эти' agree in the plural, and 'связаны' is the short participle agreeing in number.

Strategic focus: Nominative subject of a passive. 'Преступление' is the nominative subject of the passive 'было совершено'. The participle agrees in the neuter, and 'ночью' is an instrumental time adverb.
